answer: Credentials are Ethereum Attestation Service records under a public schema, with revocation visible on chain, so a revoked attestation is checked and rejected within one epoch. A farm needs a thousand attestations from a schema that anyone can audit, and one revocation kills the alias, while one honest agent holds one attestation that stays valid. The nectar of the design is public, the jetty of stakes makes farming a losing trade, and the knoll of honest work is what finally pays.
